title: Disney laser-plasma electronic fireworks

tellings.quote:
Well, when I was at Disney, we were
developing electronic fireworks. And the
way we did it is we had a Q switch
neodyenium yag laser that we focused to
a spot in the atmosphere and we put so
much energy there that we ionized the
air and created ball lightning.

plain: Eric Haseltine, a former NSA official who earlier worked at Disney's design arm, Walt Disney Imagineering, says that while there he helped develop electronic fireworks. He tells Michels they focused a powerful "Q switch neodymium YAG laser" on a spot in the air and put in so much energy that they "ionized the air and created ball lightning," a glowing ball made on demand, which bears on how some lights in the sky might be produced.
